transcript.text:
Transcription (ASR) turns **audio** into text — it needs audio files as input. Your dataset is a folder of **text files with no audio**, so there's nothing to transcribe. This request isn't possible with an audio-curation pipeline, and I won't emit a recipe.

If you actually have the audio somewhere (e.g. WAVs/FLACs alongside or referenced by those text files), point me at it and I'll build a transcription pipeline. Or, if what you meant is to **curate/filter the existing text** (e.g. treat the text files as transcripts and quality-filter them), that's a text-curation task, not audio — tell me which and I'll redirect accordingly.
